Hmm, there is the config option to turn off equipment on bots. But if you actually want to remove these items from your game it’s really not feasible.

You’d have to remove the bundles / db entries for these items - but some of our quests rely on these items to be in the game and may fail to work as intended. Similarly there is other files like bundles.json that will throw an error with this because it expects those files. So there is a few cascading issues and you can choose whether you want to go down that route. (This is at your own risk, we will not help you if you brick your mod / game with this).

DRIP incorporating retextured items and clothing is unfortunately not a pick and choose. So there is not exactly an easy way (in the sense of a config option) to make this happen.
